correctness.rationale: The basepoint-free degree-2n parametrization is generically birational by explicit coincidence alternatives. Two local expansions give Puiseux pair (n-m,n), distinct weighted leading equations and intersection n(n-m); node and delta counts meet the arithmetic genus identity. The basepoint-free Gauss triple is explicitly degree 2(m+n), with birational Gauss morphism by char-zero biduality. The affine curvature polynomial is c^2 F+G with coprime F,G, hence separable for transcendental c; its 2(m+n) roots are ordinary flexes away from nodes. Hyperplane series has vanishing orders (0,n-m,n) at each infinity preimage, and global Wronskian weights sum to 6n-6. Exact checker tests ten coprime sample pairs; the proof, not samples, establishes universal quantifiers.

A complete branchwise infinity delta/contact profile and the entire Gauss/inflection divisor are intrinsic geometry of the natural complex Lissajous family.
